title: GPT Images 2.0でストーリーボード用プロンプトを作るときは、テンプレの〇〇〇（料理名）だけ差し替えてChatGPT等に投げ、料理ごとの実際の工程に合…
content:
GPT Images 2.0でストーリーボード用プロンプトを作るときは、テンプレの〇〇〇（料理名）だけ差し替えてChatGPT等に投げ、料理ごとの実際の工程に合わせてパネル構成を動的に作らせる  
GPT Images 2.0でストーリーボードを生成する際は、生成品質を「高」に設定して安定した完成度のストーリーボードを出しやすくする  
Seedance 2.0に入る前に、生成したストーリーボードの矛盾・不自然さを必ずチェックし、問題があればChatGPT等でプロンプトを調整してストーリーボードを再生成する  
Claudeにストーリーボード画像をアップロードし、「Seedance 2.0で忠実に動画化」「物理法則に沿う」「12シーンをまとめてコピペできる形式」で各シーンの動画用プロンプトを書かせる  
Claudeが作った12シーンのプロンプト全文を、動画生成テンプレの[STEP ④で作成したプロンプトをそのまま貼り付け]プレースホルダーを削除した位置にそのまま貼り付けてSeedance 2.0用の最終プロンプトにする  
Seedance 2.0用テンプレに「ストーリーボード画像やパネル番号・字幕・UI等を動画に表示しない（参照画像を再現しない）」という回避指示を入れて、出力にボードが混入するのを防ぐ  
Seedance 2.0で生成する前に、特に音声（BGM・効果音）部分を料理に合わせて微調整し、必要ならプロンプト全文をChatGPT等に投げて最適化させる  
完成したプロンプトでSeedance 2.0を15秒動画として生成し、テンポ感はBPM 110–120程度のBGM指定などで調整する

en.content:
---
When creating prompts for storyboards with GPT Images 2.0, simply replace the template's placeholder (dish name) and submit it to ChatGPT, etc., to dynamically create panel structures according to the actual process of each dish.  
When generating a storyboard with GPT Images 2.0, set the generation quality to "high" to easily produce a stable and high-quality storyboard.  
Before entering Seedance 2.0, always check the generated storyboard for inconsistencies or unnatural elements, and if there are any issues, adjust the prompt with ChatGPT, etc., and regenerate the storyboard.  
Upload the storyboard images to Claude and have it write video prompts for each scene in a format that can be copied and pasted collectively, ensuring faithful video conversion with Seedance 2.0 and adherence to physical laws.  
Paste the full text of the 12 scene prompts created by Claude into the placeholder [STEP ④で作成したプロンプトをそのまま貼り付け] in the video generation template to create the final prompt for Seedance 2.0.  
Include an avoidance instruction in the Seedance 2.0 template to prevent the display of storyboard images, panel numbers, subtitles, UI, etc., in the video, ensuring that the board does not appear in the output.  
Before generating with Seedance 2.0, fine-tune the audio (BGM, sound effects) to match the dish, and if necessary, submit the full prompt to ChatGPT, etc., for optimization.  
Generate a 15-second video with Seedance 2.0 using the completed prompt, adjusting the tempo with a BGM specification of around BPM 110–120.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] ① Creating Prompts for GPT Images 2.0

First, have the generative AI create a prompt for making a storyboard with GPT Images 2.0.

Insert the name of the dish you want to create in the placeholder below and request it from ChatGPT, etc.
※ Only change the placeholder

Prompt↓
-----------------
I want to create a storyboard of the process of making [dish name].
The cooking location is a long-established and popular [dish name] restaurant in Tokyo.
Based on the following prompt, write a prompt that can create a storyboard with GPT Images 2.0.

# FOOD ANIME STORYBOARD GENERATOR — MASTER TEMPLATE

## Objective

Create a professional anime production storyboard sheet for a [15]-second cooking animation featuring authentic [dish name].

The cooking process should accurately reflect professional restaurant preparation techniques while delivering spectacular anime-style food presentation and [season/atmosphere].

The storyboard should depict the complete preparation process from raw ingredients to the finished dish while maintaining strict visual continuity across all panels.

---

# Workflow Adaptation Rule

The storyboard structure must be customized according to the actual cooking process of the dish.

Do NOT force every recipe into a fixed storyboard sequence.

Before creating the storyboard:

1. Identify the authentic restaurant preparation workflow.
2. Determine the most visually important cooking actions.
3. Determine which preparation steps deserve their own panels.
4. Determine which cooking steps deserve their own panels.
5. Identify the most iconic and visually appealing moment and use it as the highlight scene.
6. Build the storyboard around the natural workflow of the dish.

The storyboard must follow the actual preparation order used by professional restaurants.

The number of preparation, cooking, assembly, plating, and finishing panels may vary depending on the dish.

Examples:

* Noodle dishes may require separate panels for boiling, lifting, cooling, draining, and plating.
* Rice bowls may require additional simmering and egg-cooking panels.
* Stir-fried dishes may require multiple wok-action panels.
* Grilled dishes may require grilling, turning, and caramelization panels.
* Desserts may require mixing, shaping, decorating, and finishing panels.

Priority order:

1. Culinary accuracy
2. Natural workflow continuity
3. Visual storytelling
4. Food appeal

Panel titles, actions, and sequencing must be generated dynamically based on the dish rather than following a rigid structure.

---

# Realism and Culinary Accuracy Rules

The storyboard must prioritize authentic professional cooking techniques, realistic food behavior, and culinary accuracy over exaggerated anime action effects.

The goal is to create a storyboard that resembles a high-end food anime inspired by real restaurant craftsmanship rather than an action scene.

Visual appeal should come from:

* Professional technique
* Beautiful ingredient preparation
* Texture
* Freshness
* Temperature contrast
* Steam, condensation, and shine
* Elegant presentation
* Natural cooking workflow

Not from exaggerated motion or spectacle.

---

## Ingredient Preparation Rules

Ingredient preparation must appear clean, controlled, and professional.

When ingredients are cut or prepared:

* Show precise knife work
* Show clean cuts
* Show ingredients accumulating neatly
* Show organized preparation surfaces
* Show realistic food textures

Avoid:

* Flying vegetable fragments
* Ingredients exploding outward
* Ingredients suspended in midair
* Dramatic debris effects
* Excessive cutting impact effects
* Action-movie style knife sequences

The preparation process should look like the work of a skilled restaurant chef.

---

## Water and Liquid Realism Rules

Liquids must behave realistically.

Water, broth, oil, sauce, and other liquids should move naturally according to real-world physics.

Prefer:

* Gentle ripples
* Flowing water
* Natural pouring motion
* Small droplets
* Surface reflections
* Condensation
* Steam
* Realistic viscosity

Avoid:

* Large splash effects
* Explosive water bursts
* Water pillars
* Dramatic liquid explosions
* Excessive sauce splattering
* Unrealistic spray effects

When noodles are cooled in water, emphasize:

* Clarity of the water
* Ice cubes
* Condensation
* Subtle ripples
* Temperature contrast

Do not emphasize splash effects.

---

## Food Physics Rules

All ingredients must obey real-world physics.

Food should have realistic:

* Weight
* Volume
* Gravity
* Motion
* Texture

Avoid:

* Floating ingredients
* Gravity-defying motion
* Ingredients flying through the air
* Unrealistic stretching
* Unrealistic deformation

If a movement would not occur in a real professional kitchen, do not depict it.

---

## Professional Kitchen Workflow Rules

Cooking actions should appear:

* Skilled
* Efficient
* Controlled
* Deliberate
* Authentic

Avoid:

* Extreme action poses
* Overly dramatic movements
* Excessive motion blur
* Unrealistic speed effects
* Action-anime impact effects

Prefer:

* Natural cooking rhythm
* Restaurant workflow
* Precision
* Technique
* Professionalism

---

## Camera and Motion Rules

Camera movement should support food presentation rather than spectacle.

Prefer:

* Top-down shots
* Ingredient close-ups
* Texture close-ups
* Controlled cinematic framing
* Natural perspective

Avoid:

* Extreme fisheye distortion
* Aggressive action framing
* Overly dynamic camera angles
* Action-scene cinematography

The food should always remain the primary visual focus.

---

## Highlight Scene Rules

The highlight scene should emphasize:

* Culinary craftsmanship
* Texture
* Temperature
* Transformation
* Professional technique

Do NOT emphasize:

* Explosions
* Flying ingredients
* Splash spectacles
* Destructive motion

Examples:

Good:

* Noodles gently entering ice water
* Egg flowing into simmering broth
* Sauce glazing meat
* Tempura batter crisping in oil

Bad:

* Water exploding upward
* Vegetables flying across the frame
* Sauce erupting dramatically
* Ingredients launching into the air

---

## Output Format

* Single image
* 16:9 horizontal canvas
* Approximately 12 storyboard panels
* Panels arranged chronologically from left to right
* Clearly separated storyboard frames
* Clean and readable layout
* Professional animation production document appearance
* Text allowed only in storyboard captions
* Each panel must include a panel number and one-sentence action description
* No subtitles
* No dialogue
* No logo
* No watermark

---

# Storyboard Caption Rules

Every storyboard panel must include a caption area positioned at the bottom of the frame.

For each panel, display:

1. Panel number (01–12)
2. A short one-sentence description explaining the cooking step shown in that panel

Caption requirements:

* Located inside the bottom portion of each panel
* Consistent placement across all panels
* Clean professional storyboard formatting
* Easy to read
* Small but clearly visible
* Black text on a light caption strip
* Maximum one sentence per panel
* Caption language: English
* Number and description must appear in every panel

The caption area should resemble a genuine anime production storyboard sheet used in professional animation pre-production.

---

# Visual Style

## Core Style

* Premium Japanese food anime
* High-budget theatrical anime film
* Cinematic sakuga animation
* Detailed hand-drawn anime shading
* Gourmet anime masterpiece
* Professional production storyboard aesthetic
* [Season/atmosphere]
* Elegant culinary storytelling
* Refined restaurant atmosphere

## Animation Energy

Emphasize:

* Authentic cooking techniques
* Professional craftsmanship
* Texture transformation
* Steam and temperature contrast
* Freshness
* Gloss and reflections
* Natural food movement
* Visual continuity

The storyboard should feel like the blueprint for an elegant and visually satisfying food animation.

---

# Consistency Requirements

## Environment

* Same [kitchen type]
* Same preparation counter
* Same utensils
* Same lighting setup
* Same atmosphere
* Same restaurant environment throughout all panels

## Character

* Same cook hands
* Same forearms
* Consistent appearance throughout all panels

## Continuity

* Consistent environment design
* Consistent color palette
* Smooth visual storytelling

---
Al crear un prompt para storyboards en GPT Images 2.0, simplemente reemplaza el nombre del platillo en el template y envíalo a ChatGPT, para que se ajuste dinámicamente la estructura del panel según el proceso real de cada platillo.  
Al generar storyboards en GPT Images 2.0, configura la calidad de generación en "alta" para facilitar la obtención de storyboards con un alto grado de acabado.  
Antes de entrar en Seedance 2.0, asegúrate de revisar las inconsistencias o aspectos poco naturales del storyboard generado, y si hay problemas, ajusta el prompt con ChatGPT y regenera el storyboard.  
Sube las imágenes del storyboard a Claude y haz que escriba prompts para cada escena del video en un formato que se pueda copiar y pegar, asegurando que se "anime fielmente en Seedance 2.0" y que "se ajuste a las leyes físicas".  
Pega el texto completo de los 12 prompts de escena creados por Claude en el lugar donde se eliminó el marcador [STEP ④で作成したプロンプトをそのまま貼り付け] en la plantilla de generación de video para crear el prompt final para Seedance 2.0.  
Incluye una instrucción de evasión en la plantilla de Seedance 2.0 para "no mostrar imágenes del storyboard, números de paneles, subtítulos, UI, etc., en el video" para evitar que el tablero se mezcle en la salida.  
Antes de generar en Seedance 2.0, ajusta especialmente la parte de audio (BGM, efectos de sonido) para que coincida con el platillo, y si es necesario, lanza el texto completo del prompt a ChatGPT para optimizarlo.  
Genera el video de 15 segundos en Seedance 2.0 con el prompt finalizado, ajustando el ritmo con una especificación de BGM de BPM 110–120.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] ① Creación de prompts para GPT Images 2.0

Primero, generaremos un prompt para crear storyboards en GPT Images 2.0 con la ayuda de una IA generativa.

Inserta el nombre del platillo que deseas crear en la parte de 〇〇〇 y solicita a ChatGPT, etc.
※ Solo necesitas cambiar 〇〇〇

Prompt↓
-----------------
Quiero crear un storyboard del proceso de hacer 〇〇〇.
El lugar donde se cocina es un establecimiento tradicional popular en Tokio para 〇〇〇.
Basándote en el siguiente prompt, escribe un prompt que pueda crear un storyboard en GPT Images 2.0.

# GENERADOR DE STORYBOARD DE ANIME DE COMIDA — PLANTILLA MAESTRA

## Objetivo

Crear una hoja de storyboard de producción de anime profesional para una animación de cocina de [15] segundos que presente un [料理名] auténtico.

El proceso de cocina debe reflejar con precisión las técnicas de preparación profesional de restaurantes mientras ofrece una espectacular presentación de comida al estilo anime y [季節・雰囲気].

El storyboard debe representar el proceso completo de preparación desde los ingredientes crudos hasta el platillo terminado, manteniendo una estricta continuidad visual en todos los paneles.

---

# Regla de Adaptación del Flujo de Trabajo

La estructura del storyboard debe personalizarse de acuerdo con el proceso de cocina real del platillo.

NO fuerces cada receta en una secuencia de storyboard fija.

Antes de crear el storyboard:

1. Identifica el flujo de trabajo de preparación auténtico del restaurante.
2. Determina las acciones de cocina más importantes visualmente.
3. Determina qué pasos de preparación merecen sus propios paneles.
4. Determina qué pasos de cocina merecen sus propios paneles.
5. Identifica el momento más icónico y visualmente atractivo y úsalo como la escena destacada.
6. Construye el storyboard en torno al flujo de trabajo natural del platillo.

El storyboard debe seguir el orden de preparación real utilizado por los restaurantes profesionales.

El número de paneles de preparación, cocina, ensamblaje, emplatado y acabado puede variar según el platillo.

Ejemplos:

* Los platillos de fideos pueden requerir paneles separados para hervir, levantar, enfriar, escurrir y emplatar.
* Los tazones de arroz pueden requerir paneles adicionales para hervir a fuego lento y cocinar huevos.
* Los platillos salteados pueden requerir múltiples paneles de acción en el wok.
* Los platillos a la parrilla pueden requerir paneles de asado, volteo y caramelización.
* Los postres pueden requerir paneles de mezcla, moldeado, decoración y acabado.

Orden de prioridad:

1. Precisión culinaria
2. Continuidad del flujo de trabajo natural
3. Narración visual
4. Atractivo de la comida

Los títulos de los paneles, acciones y secuencias deben generarse dinámicamente según el platillo en lugar de seguir una estructura rígida.

---

# Reglas de Realismo y Precisión Culinaria

El storyboard debe priorizar técnicas de cocina profesional auténticas, comportamiento realista de los alimentos y precisión culinaria sobre efectos de acción exagerados al estilo anime.

El objetivo es crear un storyboard que se asemeje a un anime de comida de alta gama inspirado en la artesanía real de los restaurantes en lugar de una escena de acción.

El atractivo visual debe provenir de:

* Técnica profesional
* Preparación de ingredientes hermosa
* Textura
* Frescura
* Contraste de temperatura
* Vapor, condensación y brillo
* Presentación elegante
* Flujo de trabajo de cocina natural

No de movimiento exagerado o espectáculo.

---

## Reglas de Preparación de Ingredientes

La preparación de ingredientes debe parecer limpia, controlada y profesional.

Cuando los ingredientes se cortan o preparan:

* Muestra trabajo de cuchillo preciso
* Muestra cortes limpios
* Muestra ingredientes acumulándose ordenadamente
* Muestra superficies de preparación organizadas
* Muestra texturas de alimentos realistas

Evita:

* Fragmentos de vegetales volando
* Ingredientes explotando hacia afuera
* Ingredientes suspendidos en el aire
* Efectos dramáticos de escombros
* Efectos de impacto excesivos al cortar
* Secuencias de cuchillo al estilo de películas de acción

El proceso de preparación debe parecer el trabajo de un chef de restaurante hábil.

---

## Reglas de Realismo del Agua y Líquidos

Los líquidos deben comportarse de manera realista.

El agua, el caldo, el aceite, la salsa y otros líquidos deben moverse naturalmente de acuerdo con la física del mundo real.

Preferir:

* Ondas suaves
* Agua fluyendo
* Movimiento natural al verter
* Pequeñas gotas
* Reflejos en la superficie
* Condensación
* Vapor
* Viscosidad realista

Evitar:

* Efectos de salpicaduras grandes
* Explosiones de agua
* Columnas de agua
* Explosiones dramáticas de líquidos
* Salpicaduras excesivas de salsa
* Efectos de pulverización poco realistas

Cuando los fideos se enfrían en agua, enfatizar:

* Claridad del agua
* Cubos de hielo
* Condensación
* Ondas sutiles
* Contraste de temperatura

No enfatizar efectos de salpicaduras.

---

## Reglas de Física de los Alimentos

Todos los ingredientes deben obedecer la física del mundo real.

La comida debe tener:

* Peso realista
* Volumen
* Gravedad
* Movimiento
* Textura

Evitar:

* Ingredientes flotantes
* Movimiento que desafía la gravedad
* Ingredientes volando por el aire
* Estiramiento poco realista
* Deformación poco realista

Si un movimiento no ocurriría en una cocina profesional real, no lo representes.

---

## Reglas del Flujo de Trabajo de Cocina Profesional

Las acciones de cocina deben parecer:

* Hábiles
* Eficientes
* Controladas
* Deliberadas
* Auténticas

Evitar:

* Poses de acción extremas
* Movimientos demasiado dramáticos
* Desenfoque de movimiento excesivo
* Efectos de velocidad poco realistas
* Efectos de impacto al estilo de anime de acción

Preferir:

* Ritmo de cocina natural
* Flujo de trabajo de restaurante
* Precisión
* Técnica
* Profesionalismo

---

## Reglas de Cámara y Movimiento

El movimiento de la cámara debe apoyar la presentación de la comida en lugar del espectáculo.

Preferir:

* Tomas desde arriba
* Primeros planos de ingredientes
* Primeros planos de textura
* Encuadre cinematográfico controlado
* Perspectiva natural

Evitar:

* Distorsión extrema de ojo de pez
* Encuadre de acción agresivo
* Ángulos de cámara demasiado dinámicos
* Cinematografía de escenas de acción

La comida siempre debe ser el enfoque visual principal.

---

## Reglas de la Escena Destacada

La escena destacada debe enfatizar:

* Artesanía culinaria
* Textura
* Temperatura
* Transformación
* Técnica profesional

NO enfatizar:

* Explosiones
* Ingredientes voladores
* Espectáculos de salpicaduras
* Movimiento destructivo

Ejemplos:

Bueno:

* Fideos entrando suavemente en agua helada

Lors de la création de prompts pour des storyboards avec GPT Images 2.0, remplacez simplement le nom du plat dans le modèle et soumettez-le à ChatGPT, etc., pour générer dynamiquement la structure des panneaux en fonction des étapes réelles de chaque plat.  
Pour générer un storyboard avec GPT Images 2.0, réglez la qualité de génération sur "élevée" pour faciliter la production d'un storyboard de haute qualité.  
Avant d'utiliser Seedance 2.0, vérifiez toujours les incohérences ou les aspects non naturels du storyboard généré et, en cas de problème, ajustez le prompt avec ChatGPT, etc., pour régénérer le storyboard.  
Téléchargez l'image du storyboard sur Claude et demandez-lui d'écrire des prompts pour chaque scène vidéo, en respectant fidèlement Seedance 2.0, les lois physiques, et dans un format permettant de copier-coller les 12 scènes ensemble.  
Collez le texte intégral des prompts des 12 scènes créés par Claude à l'emplacement où le placeholder [STEP ④で作成したプロンプトをそのまま貼り付け] a été supprimé dans le modèle de génération vidéo pour créer le prompt final pour Seedance 2.0.  
Ajoutez une instruction d'évitement dans le modèle pour Seedance 2.0, indiquant de ne pas afficher les images du storyboard, les numéros de panneau, les sous-titres, l'interface utilisateur, etc., dans la vidéo, afin d'éviter que le storyboard ne soit intégré dans la sortie.

--- CONTINUATION DU FIL DE DISCUSSION ---
[Fil 1] ① Création de prompts pour GPT Images 2.0

Tout d'abord, nous allons demander à une IA de génération de créer un prompt pour réaliser un storyboard avec GPT Images 2.0.

Insérez le nom du plat que vous souhaitez créer dans la partie marquée par 〇〇〇, puis soumettez-le à ChatGPT, etc.
※ Seul le remplacement de 〇〇〇 est nécessaire

Prompt↓
-----------------
Je souhaite créer un storyboard des étapes de préparation de 〇〇〇.
Le lieu de préparation est un établissement renommé de 〇〇〇 à Tokyo.
Sur la base du prompt suivant, écrivez un prompt pour créer un storyboard avec GPT Images 2.0.

# GÉNÉRATEUR DE STORYBOARD D'ANIME CULINAIRE — MODÈLE PRINCIPAL

## Objectif

Créer une feuille de storyboard de production d'anime professionnel pour une animation culinaire de [15] secondes mettant en vedette un [料理名] authentique.

Le processus de cuisson doit refléter avec précision les techniques de préparation professionnelle utilisées dans les restaurants tout en offrant une présentation spectaculaire de la nourriture à la manière d'un anime et [季節・雰囲気].

Le storyboard doit dépeindre le processus de préparation complet, des ingrédients bruts au plat fini, tout en maintenant une continuité visuelle stricte à travers tous les panneaux.

---

# Règle d'Adaptation du Flux de Travail

La structure du storyboard doit être personnalisée en fonction du processus de cuisson réel du plat.

Ne forcez PAS chaque recette dans une séquence de storyboard fixe.

Avant de créer le storyboard :

1. Identifiez le flux de travail authentique de préparation au restaurant.
2. Déterminez les actions culinaires les plus importantes visuellement.
3. Déterminez quelles étapes de préparation méritent leurs propres panneaux.
4. Déterminez quelles étapes de cuisson méritent leurs propres panneaux.
5. Identifiez le moment le plus emblématique et visuellement attrayant et utilisez-le comme scène phare.
6. Construisez le storyboard autour du flux de travail naturel du plat.

Le storyboard doit suivre l'ordre de préparation réel utilisé par les restaurants professionnels.

Le nombre de panneaux de préparation, de cuisson, d'assemblage, de dressage et de finition peut varier en fonction du plat.

Exemples :

* Les plats de nouilles peuvent nécessiter des panneaux séparés pour l'ébullition, le levage, le refroidissement, l'égouttage et le dressage.
* Les bols de riz peuvent nécessiter des panneaux supplémentaires pour le mijotage et la cuisson des œufs.
* Les plats sautés peuvent nécessiter plusieurs panneaux d'action au wok.
* Les plats grillés peuvent nécessiter des panneaux pour le grillage, le retournement et la caramélisation.
* Les desserts peuvent nécessiter des panneaux pour le mélange, le façonnage, la décoration et la finition.

Ordre de priorité :

1. Précision culinaire
2. Continuité du flux de travail naturel
3. Narration visuelle
4. Attrait culinaire

Les titres des panneaux, les actions et la séquence doivent être générés dynamiquement en fonction du plat plutôt que de suivre une structure rigide.

---

# Règles de Réalisme et de Précision Culinaire

Le storyboard doit privilégier les techniques de cuisson professionnelles authentiques, le comportement réaliste des aliments et la précision culinaire par rapport aux effets d'action exagérés des animes.

L'objectif est de créer un storyboard qui ressemble à un anime culinaire haut de gamme inspiré par l'artisanat réel des restaurants plutôt qu'à une scène d'action.

L'attrait visuel doit provenir de :

* Technique professionnelle
* Belle préparation des ingrédients
* Texture
* Fraîcheur
* Contraste de température
* Vapeur, condensation et éclat
* Présentation élégante
* Flux de travail culinaire naturel

Pas d'un mouvement exagéré ou spectaculaire.

---

## Règles de Préparation des Ingrédients

La préparation des ingrédients doit apparaître propre, contrôlée et professionnelle.

Lorsque les ingrédients sont coupés ou préparés :

* Montrez un travail de couteau précis
* Montrez des coupes nettes
* Montrez les ingrédients s'accumulant proprement
* Montrez des surfaces de préparation organisées
* Montrez des textures alimentaires réalistes

Évitez :

* Fragments de légumes volants
* Ingrédients explosant vers l'extérieur
* Ingrédients suspendus en l'air
* Effets de débris dramatiques
* Effets d'impact de coupe excessifs
* Séquences de couteau de style film d'action

Le processus de préparation doit ressembler au travail d'un chef de restaurant qualifié.

---

## Règles de Réalisme de l'Eau et des Liquides

Les liquides doivent se comporter de manière réaliste.

L'eau, le bouillon, l'huile, la sauce et autres liquides doivent se déplacer naturellement selon les lois physiques du monde réel.

Préférez :

* Ondulations douces
* Eau qui coule
* Mouvement de versement naturel
* Petites gouttelettes
* Réflexions de surface
* Condensation
* Vapeur
* Viscosité réaliste

Évitez :

* Grands effets d'éclaboussures
* Explosions d'eau
* Piliers d'eau
* Explosions dramatiques de liquides
* Éclaboussures excessives de sauce
* Effets de pulvérisation irréalistes

Lorsque les nouilles sont refroidies dans l'eau, mettez l'accent sur :

* Clarté de l'eau
* Glaçons
* Condensation
* Ondulations subtiles
* Contraste de température

Ne mettez pas l'accent sur les effets d'éclaboussures.

---

## Règles de Physique Alimentaire

Tous les ingrédients doivent obéir aux lois physiques du monde réel.

Les aliments doivent avoir un réalisme en termes de :

* Poids
* Volume
* Gravité
* Mouvement
* Texture

Évitez :

* Ingrédients flottants
* Mouvement défiant la gravité
* Ingrédients volant dans les airs
* Étirement irréaliste
* Déformation irréaliste

Si un mouvement ne se produirait pas dans une cuisine professionnelle réelle, ne le représentez pas.

---

## Règles de Flux de Travail en Cuisine Professionnelle

Les actions culinaires doivent apparaître :

* Habiles
* Efficaces
* Contrôlées
* Délibérées
* Authentiques

Évitez :

* Poses d'action extrêmes
* Mouvements trop dramatiques
* Flou de mouvement excessif
* Effets de vitesse irréalistes
* Effets d'impact de style anime d'action

Préférez :

* Rythme culinaire naturel
* Flux de travail de restaurant
* Précision
* Technique
* Professionnalisme

---

## Règles de Caméra et de Mouvement

Le mouvement de la caméra doit soutenir la présentation culinaire plutôt que le spectacle.

Préférez :

* Prises de vue en plongée
* Gros plans d'ingrédients
* Gros plans de texture
* Cadrage cinémat

# FOOD ANIME STORYBOARD GENERATOR — MASTER TEMPLATE

## Objective

Create a professional anime production storyboard sheet for a [15]-second cooking animation featuring authentic [料理名].

The cooking process should accurately reflect professional restaurant preparation techniques while delivering spectacular anime-style food presentation and [季節・雰囲気].

The storyboard should depict the complete preparation process from raw ingredients to the finished dish while maintaining strict visual continuity across all panels.

---

# Workflow Adaptation Rule

The storyboard structure must be customized according to the actual cooking process of the dish.

Do NOT force every recipe into a fixed storyboard sequence.

Before creating the storyboard:

1. Identify the authentic restaurant preparation workflow.
2. Determine the most visually important cooking actions.
3. Determine which preparation steps deserve their own panels.
4. Determine which cooking steps deserve their own panels.
5. Identify the most iconic and visually appealing moment and use it as the highlight scene.
6. Build the storyboard around the natural workflow of the dish.

The storyboard must follow the actual preparation order used by professional restaurants.

The number of preparation, cooking, assembly, plating, and finishing panels may vary depending on the dish.

Examples:

* Noodle dishes may require separate panels for boiling, lifting, cooling, draining, and plating.
* Rice bowls may require additional simmering and egg-cooking panels.
* Stir-fried dishes may require multiple wok-action panels.
* Grilled dishes may require grilling, turning, and caramelization panels.
* Desserts may require mixing, shaping, decorating, and finishing panels.

Priority order:

1. Culinary accuracy
2. Natural workflow continuity
3. Visual storytelling
4. Food appeal

Panel titles, actions, and sequencing must be generated dynamically based on the dish rather than following a rigid structure.

---

# Realism and Culinary Accuracy Rules

The storyboard must prioritize authentic professional cooking techniques, realistic food behavior, and culinary accuracy over exaggerated anime action effects.

The goal is to create a storyboard that resembles a high-end food anime inspired by real restaurant craftsmanship rather than an action scene.

Visual appeal should come from:

* Professional technique
* Beautiful ingredient preparation
* Texture
* Freshness
* Temperature contrast
* Steam, condensation, and shine
* Elegant presentation
* Natural cooking workflow

Not from exaggerated motion or spectacle.

---

## Ingredient Preparation Rules

Ingredient preparation must appear clean, controlled, and professional.

When ingredients are cut or prepared:

* Show precise knife work
* Show clean cuts
* Show ingredients accumulating neatly
* Show organized preparation surfaces
* Show realistic food textures

Avoid:

* Flying vegetable fragments
* Ingredients exploding outward
* Ingredients suspended in midair
* Dramatic debris effects
* Excessive cutting impact effects
* Action-movie style knife sequences

The preparation process should look like the work of a skilled restaurant chef.

---

## Water and Liquid Realism Rules

Liquids must behave realistically.

Water, broth, oil, sauce, and other liquids should move naturally according to real-world physics.

Prefer:

* Gentle ripples
* Flowing water
* Natural pouring motion
* Small droplets
* Surface reflections
* Condensation
* Steam
* Realistic viscosity

Avoid:

* Large splash effects
* Explosive water bursts
* Water pillars
* Dramatic liquid explosions
* Excessive sauce splattering
* Unrealistic spray effects

When noodles are cooled in water, emphasize:

* Clarity of the water
* Ice cubes
* Condensation
* Subtle ripples
* Temperature contrast

Do not emphasize splash effects.

---

## Food Physics Rules

All ingredients must obey real-world physics.

Food should have realistic:

* Weight
* Volume
* Gravity
* Motion
* Texture

Avoid:

* Floating ingredients
* Gravity-defying motion
* Ingredients flying through the air
* Unrealistic stretching
* Unrealistic deformation

If a movement would not occur in a real professional kitchen, do not depict it.

---

## Professional Kitchen Workflow Rules

Cooking actions should appear:

* Skilled
* Efficient
* Controlled
* Deliberate
* Authentic

Avoid:

* Extreme action poses
* Overly dramatic movements
* Excessive motion blur
* Unrealistic speed effects
* Action-anime impact effects

Prefer:

* Natural cooking rhythm
* Restaurant workflow
* Precision
* Technique
* Professionalism

---

## Camera and Motion Rules

Camera movement should support food presentation rather than spectacle.

Prefer:

* Top-down shots
* Ingredient close-ups
* Texture close-ups
* Controlled cinematic framing
* Natural perspective

Avoid:

* Extreme fisheye distortion
* Aggressive action framing
* Overly dynamic camera angles
* Action-scene cinematography

The food should always remain the primary visual focus.

---

## Highlight Scene Rules

The highlight scene should emphasize:

* Culinary craftsmanship
* Texture
* Temperature
* Transformation
* Professional technique

Do NOT emphasize:

* Explosions
* Flying ingredients
* Splash spectacles
* Destructive motion

Examples:

Good:

* Noodles gently entering ice water
* Egg flowing into simmering broth
* Sauce glazing meat
* Tempura batter crisping in oil

Bad:

* Water exploding upward
* Vegetables flying across the frame
* Sauce erupting dramatically
* Ingredients launching into the air

---

## Output Format

* Single image
* 16:9 horizontal canvas
* Approximately 12 storyboard panels
* Panels arranged chronologically from left to right
* Clearly separated storyboard frames
* Clean and readable layout
* Professional animation production document appearance
* Text allowed only in storyboard captions
* Each panel must include a panel number and one-sentence action description
* No subtitles
* No dialogue
* No logo
* No watermark

---

# Storyboard Caption Rules

Every storyboard panel must include a caption area positioned at the bottom of the frame.

For each panel, display:

1. Panel number (01–12)
2. A short one-sentence description explaining the cooking step shown in that panel

Caption requirements:

* Located inside the bottom portion of each panel
* Consistent placement across all panels
* Clean professional storyboard formatting
* Easy to read
* Small but clearly visible
* Black text on a light caption strip
* Maximum one sentence per panel
* Caption language: English
* Number and description must appear in every panel

The caption area should resemble a genuine anime production storyboard sheet used in professional animation pre-production.

---

# Visual Style

## Core Style

* Premium Japanese food anime
* High-budget theatrical anime film
* Cinematic sakuga

# GERADOR DE STORYBOARD DE ANIME DE COMIDA — TEMPLATE MASTER

## Objetivo

Criar uma folha de storyboard de produção de anime profissional para uma animação de culinária de [15] segundos apresentando um autêntico [料理名].

O processo de culinária deve refletir com precisão as técnicas de preparação de restaurantes profissionais enquanto entrega uma apresentação espetacular de comida em estilo anime e [季節・雰囲気].

O storyboard deve retratar o processo completo de preparação, desde os ingredientes crus até o prato finalizado, mantendo uma continuidade visual rigorosa em todos os painéis.

---

# Regra de Adaptação do Fluxo de Trabalho

A estrutura do storyboard deve ser personalizada de acordo com o processo real de preparação do prato.

NÃO force todas as receitas em uma sequência de storyboard fixa.

Antes de criar o storyboard:

1. Identifique o fluxo de trabalho autêntico de preparação de restaurante.
2. Determine as ações culinárias visualmente mais importantes.
3. Determine quais etapas de preparação merecem seus próprios painéis.
4. Determine quais etapas de cozimento merecem seus próprios painéis.
5. Identifique o momento mais icônico e visualmente atraente e use-o como a cena de destaque.
6. Construa o storyboard em torno do fluxo de trabalho natural do prato.

O storyboard deve seguir a ordem real de preparação usada por restaurantes profissionais.

O número de painéis de preparação, cozimento, montagem, empratamento e finalização pode variar dependendo do prato.

Exemplos:

* Pratos de macarrão podem exigir painéis separados para fervura, levantamento, resfriamento, drenagem e empratamento.
* Tigelas de arroz podem exigir painéis adicionais de cozimento e preparo de ovos.
* Pratos fritos podem exigir múltiplos painéis de ação no wok.
* Pratos grelhados podem exigir painéis de grelhar, virar e caramelização.
* Sobremesas podem exigir painéis de mistura, modelagem, decoração e finalização.

Ordem de prioridade:

1. Precisão culinária
2. Continuidade do fluxo de trabalho natural
3. Narrativa visual
4. Atração alimentar

Os títulos dos painéis, ações e sequenciamento devem ser gerados dinamicamente com base no prato, em vez de seguir uma estrutura rígida.

---

# Regras de Realismo e Precisão Culinária

O storyboard deve priorizar técnicas de culinária profissional autênticas, comportamento realista dos alimentos e precisão culinária sobre efeitos de ação exagerados de anime.

O objetivo é criar um storyboard que se assemelhe a um anime de comida de alto nível inspirado no artesanato real de restaurantes, em vez de uma cena de ação.

A atração visual deve vir de:

* Técnica profissional
* Preparação de ingredientes bonita
* Textura
* Frescor
* Contraste de temperatura
* Vapor, condensação e brilho
* Apresentação elegante
* Fluxo de trabalho de culinária natural

Não de movimento exagerado ou espetáculo.

---

## Regras de Preparação de Ingredientes

A preparação dos ingredientes deve parecer limpa, controlada e profissional.

Quando os ingredientes são cortados ou preparados:

* Mostre trabalho preciso com a faca
* Mostre cortes limpos
* Mostre ingredientes se acumulando ordenadamente
* Mostre superfícies de preparação organizadas
* Mostre texturas realistas dos alimentos

Evite:

* Fragmentos de vegetais voando
* Ingredientes explodindo para fora
* Ingredientes suspensos no ar
* Efeitos dramáticos de detritos
* Efeitos de impacto excessivos de corte
* Sequências de faca no estilo de filme de ação

O processo de preparação deve parecer o trabalho de um chef de restaurante habilidoso.

---

## Regras de Realismo de Água e Líquidos

Os líquidos devem se comportar de maneira realista.

Água, caldo, óleo, molho e outros líquidos devem se mover naturalmente de acordo com as leis da física do mundo real.

Prefira:

* Ondulações suaves
* Água fluindo
* Movimento natural de derramamento
* Pequenas gotas
* Reflexões de superfície
* Condensação
* Vapor
* Viscosidade realista

Evite:

* Grandes efeitos de respingo
* Explosões de água
* Colunas de água
* Explosões dramáticas de líquidos
* Espirros excessivos de molho
* Efeitos de spray irreais

Quando os noodles são resfriados na água, enfatize:

* Clareza da água
* Cubos de gelo
* Condensação
* Ondulações sutis
* Contraste de temperatura

Não enfatize efeitos de respingo.

---

## Regras de Física dos Alimentos

Todos os ingredientes devem obedecer às leis da física do mundo real.

Os alimentos devem ter:

* Peso realista
* Volume
* Gravidade
* Movimento
* Textura

Evite:

* Ingredientes flutuantes
* Movimento desafiando a gravidade
* Ingredientes voando pelo ar
* Alongamento irrealista
* Deformação irrealista

Se um movimento não ocorreria em uma cozinha profissional real, não o represente.

---

## Regras de Fluxo de Trabalho de Cozinha Profissional

As ações de cozimento devem parecer:

* Habilidosas
* Eficientes
* Controladas
* Deliberadas
* Autênticas

Evite:

* Poses de ação extremas
* Movimentos excessivamente dramáticos
* Desfoque de movimento excessivo
* Efeitos de velocidade irrealistas
* Efeitos de impacto de anime de ação

Prefira:

* Ritmo natural de cozimento
* Fluxo de trabalho de restaurante
* Precisão
* Técnica
* Profissionalismo

---

## Regras de Câmera e Movimento

O movimento da câmera deve apoiar a apresentação dos alimentos em vez do espetáculo.

Prefira:

* Planos de cima para baixo
* Close-ups de ingredientes
* Close-ups de textura
* Enquadramento cinematográfico controlado
* Perspectiva natural

Evite:

* Distorção extrema de olho de peixe
* Enquadramento de ação agressivo
* Ângulos de câmera excessivamente dinâmicos
* Cinematografia de cena de ação

Os alimentos devem sempre permanecer o foco visual principal.

---

## Regras da Cena de Destaque

A cena de destaque deve enfatizar:

* Artesanato culinário
* Textura
* Temperatura
* Transformação
* Técnica profissional

NÃO enfatize:

* Explosões
* Ingredientes voando
* Espetáculos de respingo
* Movimento destrutivo

Exemplos:

Bom:

* Noodles entrando suavemente na água gelada
* Ovo

# FOOD ANIME STORYBOARD GENERATOR — MASTER TEMPLATE

## Objective

Create a professional anime production storyboard sheet for a [15]-second cooking animation featuring authentic [料理名].

The cooking process should accurately reflect professional restaurant preparation techniques while delivering spectacular anime-style food presentation and [季节・雰囲気].

The storyboard should depict the complete preparation process from raw ingredients to the finished dish while maintaining strict visual continuity across all panels.

---

# Workflow Adaptation Rule

The storyboard structure must be customized according to the actual cooking process of the dish.

Do NOT force every recipe into a fixed storyboard sequence.

Before creating the storyboard:

1. Identify the authentic restaurant preparation workflow.
2. Determine the most visually important cooking actions.
3. Determine which preparation steps deserve their own panels.
4. Determine which cooking steps deserve their own panels.
5. Identify the most iconic and visually appealing moment and use it as the highlight scene.
6. Build the storyboard around the natural workflow of the dish.

The storyboard must follow the actual preparation order used by professional restaurants.

The number of preparation, cooking, assembly, plating, and finishing panels may vary depending on the dish.

Examples:

* Noodle dishes may require separate panels for boiling, lifting, cooling, draining, and plating.
* Rice bowls may require additional simmering and egg-cooking panels.
* Stir-fried dishes may require multiple wok-action panels.
* Grilled dishes may require grilling, turning, and caramelization panels.
* Desserts may require mixing, shaping, decorating, and finishing panels.

Priority order:

1. Culinary accuracy
2. Natural workflow continuity
3. Visual storytelling
4. Food appeal

Panel titles, actions, and sequencing must be generated dynamically based on the dish rather than following a rigid structure.

---

# Realism and Culinary Accuracy Rules

The storyboard must prioritize authentic professional cooking techniques, realistic food behavior, and culinary accuracy over exaggerated anime action effects.

The goal is to create a storyboard that resembles a high-end food anime inspired by real restaurant craftsmanship rather than an action scene.

Visual appeal should come from:

* Professional technique
* Beautiful ingredient preparation
* Texture
* Freshness
* Temperature contrast
* Steam, condensation, and shine
* Elegant presentation
* Natural cooking workflow

Not from exaggerated motion or spectacle.

---

## Ingredient Preparation Rules

Ingredient preparation must appear clean, controlled, and professional.

When ingredients are cut or prepared:

* Show precise knife work
* Show clean cuts
* Show ingredients accumulating neatly
* Show organized preparation surfaces
* Show realistic food textures

Avoid:

* Flying vegetable fragments
* Ingredients exploding outward
* Ingredients suspended in midair
* Dramatic debris effects
* Excessive cutting impact effects
* Action-movie style knife sequences

The preparation process should look like the work of a skilled restaurant chef.

---

## Water and Liquid Realism Rules

Liquids must behave realistically.

Water, broth, oil, sauce, and other liquids should move naturally according to real-world physics.

Prefer:

* Gentle ripples
* Flowing water
* Natural pouring motion
* Small droplets
* Surface reflections
* Condensation
* Steam
* Realistic viscosity

Avoid:

* Large splash effects
* Explosive water bursts
* Water pillars
* Dramatic liquid explosions
* Excessive sauce splattering
* Unrealistic spray effects

When noodles are cooled in water, emphasize:

* Clarity of the water
* Ice cubes
* Condensation
* Subtle ripples
* Temperature contrast

Do not emphasize splash effects.

---

## Food Physics Rules

All ingredients must obey real-world physics.

Food should have realistic:

* Weight
* Volume
* Gravity
* Motion
* Texture

Avoid:

* Floating ingredients
* Gravity-defying motion
* Ingredients flying through the air
* Unrealistic stretching
* Unrealistic deformation

If a movement would not occur in a real professional kitchen, do not depict it.

---

## Professional Kitchen Workflow Rules

Cooking actions should appear:

* Skilled
* Efficient
* Controlled
* Deliberate
* Authentic

Avoid:

* Extreme action poses
* Overly dramatic movements
* Excessive motion blur
* Unrealistic speed effects
* Action-anime impact effects

Prefer:

* Natural cooking rhythm
* Restaurant workflow
* Precision
* Technique
* Professionalism

---

## Camera and Motion Rules

Camera movement should support food presentation rather than spectacle.

Prefer:

* Top-down shots
* Ingredient close-ups
* Texture close-ups
* Controlled cinematic framing
* Natural perspective

Avoid:

* Extreme fisheye distortion
* Aggressive action framing
* Overly dynamic camera angles
* Action-scene cinematography

The food should always remain the primary visual focus.

---

## Highlight Scene Rules

The highlight scene should emphasize:

* Culinary craftsmanship
* Texture
* Temperature
* Transformation
* Professional technique

Do NOT emphasize:

* Explosions
* Flying ingredients
* Splash spectacles
* Destructive motion

Examples:

Good:

* Noodles gently entering ice water
* Egg flowing into simmering broth
* Sauce glazing meat
* Tempura batter crisping in oil

Bad:

* Water exploding upward
* Vegetables flying across the frame
* Sauce erupting dramatically
* Ingredients launching into the air

---

## Output Format

* Single image
* 16:9 horizontal canvas
* Approximately 12 storyboard panels
* Panels arranged chronologically from left to right
* Clearly separated storyboard frames
* Clean and readable layout
* Professional animation production document appearance
* Text allowed only in storyboard captions
* Each panel must include a panel number and one-sentence action description
* No subtitles
* No dialogue
* No logo
* No watermark

---

# Storyboard Caption Rules

Every storyboard panel must include a caption area positioned at the bottom of the frame.

For each panel, display:

1. Panel number (01–12)
2. A short one-sentence description explaining the cooking step shown in that panel

Caption requirements:

* Located inside the bottom portion of each panel
* Consistent placement across all panels
* Clean professional storyboard formatting
* Easy to read
* Small but clearly visible
* Black text on a light caption strip
* Maximum one sentence per panel
* Caption language: English
* Number and description must appear in every panel

The caption area should resemble a genuine anime production storyboard sheet used in professional animation pre-production.

---

## Core Style

* Premium Japanese food anime
* High-budget theatrical anime film
* Cinematic sakuga animation
* Detailed hand-drawn anime shading
* Gourmet anime masterpiece
* Professional production storyboard aesthetic
* [季节・雰囲気]

* Refined restaurant atmosphere

Emphasize:

* Professional craftsmanship
* Texture transformation
* Steam and temperature contrast
* Freshness
* Gloss and reflections
* Natural food movement
* Visual continuity

The storyboard should feel like the blueprint for an elegant and visually satisfying food animation.

* Same preparation counter
* Same utensils
* Same lighting setup
* Same atmosphere
* Same restaurant environment throughout all panels

* Consistent appearance throughout all panels
